outcome: Prevalence of hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP)
Median gestational age at time of delivery
cohort: The cohort consisted of 9,974 singleton deliveries (5,011 in 2020 and 4,963 in 2019) from four large-volume hospitals.
finding: There was a statistically significant increase in the rate of HDP during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to the pre-COVID era, but no significant difference in the proportion of severe disease or gestational age at delivery among women with HDP.
